sentences.text:
The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, 'Code'),
for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioner is the 4th accused in Crime No.1289/2023 of the Paripally Police Station, Kollam,
registered against the accused for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 294(b), 420, 406, 407, 447 and 506 r/w 34 the of Indian Penal Code.

3. Heard; Sri.B.G. Harindranath, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt. Seetha.S,
the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents.
4.
The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that the police after investigation have found that the petitioner is not involved in crime.
The police have laid the final report only as against the 3 rd accused in the crime, who is presently the sole accused.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is closed.

Sd/-
C.S.DIAS, JUDGE mtk/16/1/2024 V. Ashtavarman vs State Of Kerala on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61864459/
